data: Which line in the third row of plots represents the 'ComNet' agent?

The caption states that ComNet achieved performance close to the upper bound (hand-crafted). In the figure, the hand-crafted line is represented by a dotted line. The ComNet line is represented by a solid line. Therefore, the solid line in the third row of plots represents the 'ComNet' agent.
